standard_prerequisites.name: The characterisation of morphisms representable by algebraic spaces through faithfulness, and the description of the relative inertia as the kernel of the functor on isomorphism sheaves
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1717-1734) as pointers to results of the chapter on algebraic stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: Translates representability into a condition on the kernel of the map on Isom sheaves and identifies that kernel with a fibre product of the inertia.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the second diagonal as the identity section of the relative inertia group stack
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The statement uses the second diagonal and the relative inertia interchangeably, and the proof invokes the lemma identifying the kernel of the Isom map with a fibre product of the inertia
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the object whose triviality is equivalent to the conditions of the statement.

core_obligations: First equivalence: the proof recalls that representability by algebraic spaces is equivalent to faithfulness, that faithfulness is equivalent to injectivity of the maps on isomorphism sheaves, and that this is equivalent to the triviality of the kernel, which is the second diagonal (proof lines 1716-1728)
Second equivalence: a group stack is trivial exactly when its identity section is an isomorphism (proof lines 1729-1731)
Third equivalence: the kernel appearing in the last condition corresponds to the fibre product of the inertia along the given point, as seen in the proof of the inertia lemma (proof lines 1731-1734)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇔(2)：可表示 ⟺ f 忠实 ⟺ 对每个 x: T → X 有 Isom_X(x,x) → Isom_Y(f(x),f(x)) 单 ⟺ 核 K 平凡 ⟺ e: T → K 是同构；而 K = T ×_{x,X} I_{X/Y} 正是第二对角。
(2)⇔(3)：群叠平凡 ⟺ 其单位截面是同构。(3)⇔(4)：由定义与 lemma-inertia 的证明中「(4) 的核对应纤维积 T ×_{x,X} I_{X/Y}」即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects four equivalent conditions: representability of the morphism by algebraic spaces, triviality of its second diagonal, triviality of the relative inertia group stack, and triviality of the kernel of the comparison map on isomorphism sheaves (author lemma at source lines 1700-1713, label lemma-second-diagonal). The proof (source lines 1715-1735) chains the characterisation of representability through faithfulness into the injectivity of the maps on isomorphism sheaves, identifies the kernel with a fibre product of the relative inertia, and disposes of the remaining equivalences by the triviality criterion for a group stack and by the identification of the kernel used in the inertia lemma (proof lines 1716-1734). The chain of translations between the four conditions is the content. H2.
